project.name: VexelRay GUI :: Harness
project.description: Drives a real GuiApp frame loop under a test's control: synthetic input, an observable frame budget, and a wait that only ends when something actually asks for a frame. Shipped rather than test-scoped so an application can assert its own interaction end to end — the loop is where render-on-demand goes wrong, and a click that produces no frame is invisible to every unit test that calls Gui.frame() by hand.
